content_sections.heading: HCL FTE Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Discipline & Grade-wise)
content_sections.text: 11 Disciplines/Cadres 6 Grades (FTE-I to FTE-VI) 43 Total Posts Note: For the Survey discipline, the official table lists 3 total FTE-I posts but shows a category break-up of only “UR:1” against them – this is reproduced exactly as it appears in the source notification; the break-up for the remaining 2 posts is not specified there. Category/vacancy numbers are subject to change per organizational requirement. PwBD candidates appointed will be adjusted against the vacancy of their respective category (UR/SC/OBC). Only persons with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible under PwBD. Disablement categories identified per discipline are specified in the official notification (Geology, Environment Management, Mineral Processing, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, M&HS, Human Resources, Finance, and Survey each have specific identified categories); the Industrial Safety discipline/cadre is not identified suitable for PwBDs .

content_sections.heading: HCL FTE Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Experience is reckoned only from the date of obtaining the basic/essential qualification prescribed for the post (i.e., from the date of result publication of that qualification). Experience is counted only if in the relevant field – working experience in the advertised cadre/discipline in a Mining/Metal/Manufacturing industry, or in any other industry subject to submission of an Experience Certificate meeting HCL’s domain requirement (assessed at document verification). Applicants must upload at least 2 of the following for each employment: Appointment Letter, Pay Slip, Form-16, PF Statement, or Bank Statement (towards salary credit). Failure to do so leads to cancellation of candidature. Experience gained through Training, Consultancy, Teaching, Fellowship, Internship, Apprenticeship, or Academic Project is NOT counted as experience.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology with PG Degree/Diploma in Safety Engineering Mgt., or B.Tech in Safety/Fire Engineering
Post Graduate Degree in Geology/Applied Geology
Bachelor Degree in Mechanical Engineering/Mining Machinery

MBBS from an MCI-recognized institute with minimum 3 years’ experience (including at least 1 year in emergency services or Occupational Health services); OR, if PG Diploma, minimum 3 years’ experience after diploma in the clinical field. Valid MCI/State registration and relevant experience certificates required.

Bachelor Degree in Environment Engineering/Technology, OR Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology with PG Degree/Diploma in Environmental Engineering/Management/Science, OR Post Graduate Degree in Environment Science
B.Tech/B.E. in Mineral and Metallurgical Engineering, Mineral Engineering, or Mineral Processing; OR M.Tech in the same fields
MBA with specialization in Personnel Management/HR, or PG Degree/Diploma in Personnel Management/HR, OR Master’s in Social Work acceptable under Labour Legislation for working as Welfare Officer
Passed Final Examination of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, or the Institute of Cost Accountants of India
Bachelor Degree in Mining/Civil Engineering with Surveyor Certificate of Competency, or M.Tech (Geomatics)

content_sections.heading: HCL FTE Recruitment 2026 Compensation Package
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are entitled to the Consolidated Pay for their grade (see the table above), Employer’s PF Contribution, HRA, gratuity, medical benefits, leave encashment, and all other applicable benefits under HCL’s “Scheme for Engagement of Executives on Fixed Tenure Basis”.

content_sections.heading: HCL FTE Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based entirely on performance in the Personal Interview (PI) – 100% weightage . There is no written exam by default, though HCL reserves the right to conduct a written screening test to shortlist candidates for the interview, if required. Candidates are called for interview in the ratio of 1:5 (5 candidates per advertised vacancy); for a single vacancy, 10 candidates are shortlisted. If fewer than 5 applications are received for a post, the Selection Committee will assess and state the suitability of the interviewed candidates directly. Further shortlisting may be done from the eligible pool if posts remain vacant due to low turnout or an exhausted waitlist. Shortlisting criteria: 1 mark for each completed year of relevant experience beyond the minimum requirement (1/365 mark per additional day for incomplete years); 1 mark for each additional relevant degree over the minimum essential qualification, up to a maximum of 2 marks. HCL may add further criteria if required. Interview intimation is communicated by email only; call letters are issued to shortlisted candidates. Requests to change the interview/test date, time or venue once communicated will not be entertained. Candidates must bring an Original ID Card (Aadhaar, Driving Licence, or Voter ID) to the interview venue. Original documents (as listed under Documents Required below) will be verified at the interview; non-production of originals will debar the candidate from appearing.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HCL FTE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit hindustancopper.com and register under the Career section, using the online application link. Read the “How to fill the Online Application Form” instructions on the website before proceeding. Fill in all mandatory details: qualifying degree details, exact percentage of marks (do not round off), email address, mobile number, correspondence address, and upload a scanned photograph and signature (JPEG) along with scanned qualification and experience documents. Submit the application to receive your Application Number. Print the Computer-Generated Online Application and the Acknowledgement Slip, and keep copies for your records. Important: No hard copy of the application is accepted. Applications are screened purely on the information furnished online, without document verification at that stage, so candidates must ensure they genuinely meet all eligibility criteria before applying. Submit well in advance of the closing date.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Date of Birth proof: Xth Standard Passing Certificate indicating DOB, OR School Leaving Certificate/Birth Certificate XIIth Standard Passing Certificate Mark sheets of Graduate/Post Graduate Degree and/or Professional Qualification, as applicable Graduate/Post Graduate Degree or Professional Qualification Certificate (Provisional certificate accepted if the Final Degree Certificate is not yet available) Experience Certificate for each declared organization, containing Designation, Department, Date of Joining, Date of Leaving, and job description/responsibility (date-specific if responsibility changed) Salary Slip & Bank Statement for the last 3 months / PF Statement / Appointment Letter and latest Form-16 of the last employment Any Statutory Certificate defined under the eligibility criteria for the applied discipline (e.g., MCI registration for M&HS, Surveyor Certificate of Competency for Survey) CGPA/GPA/SGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate from the University/Institute, where letter grades were awarded Caste/Category Certificate in the Government of India prescribed format, for SC/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates; OBC (NCL) certificate must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 (a certificate issued before that date may be used at application stage, subject to producing the valid one at joining) Self-certified English/Hindi translation of the SC/OBC certificate, if originally issued in another language Minimum any 2 of: Appointment Letter/Pay Slip/Form-16/PF Statement/Bank Statement (towards salary credit), for each declared employment, to be uploaded in the online application itself

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has Hindustan Copper Limited advertised?
faq.answer: 43 Fixed Tenure Executive posts across 11 disciplines and Grades FTE-I to FTE-VI, vide Advertisement No. Estt./1/2036/2026-27 dated 16.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 5 October 2026, till 11:00 PM; the application window opens on 21 September 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No, by default; selection is 100% based on the Personal Interview, though HCL may conduct a written screening test to shortlist candidates if required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It varies by grade: 35 years (FTE-I), 40 years (FTE-II), 42 years (FTE-III), 47 years (FTE-IV), and 52 years (FTE-VI), as on 1 September 2026, with age relaxation for SC/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q5. What is the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: It ranges from ₹75,400/- (FTE-I) to ₹1,69,600/- (FTE-VI), depending on the grade.

faq.question: Q6. What is the tenure of engagement?
faq.answer: 3 years, extendable by a further 3 years as per requirement.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a minimum salary requirement to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must currently (or in their last job) be drawing a monthly gross salary of at least ₹40,000–₹90,000, depending on the grade applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹500/- for General & OBC candidates; SC/PwBD candidates are exempted. Payment is online only, via Payment Gateway/NEFT.

faq.question: Q9. Where do I apply?
faq.answer: Online only, through the Career section of hindustancopper.com; no hard-copy applications are accepted.
